defects_argued.quote: Having failed, this Court is of the view that the opportunity, if any, that was granted was not real but illusory.

It is submitted that the petitioner in fact submitted a reply, dated 25.05.2022, the impugned order does not even contain a reference to the said reply, clearly showing non-application of mind to the material on record.

outcome.quote: Therefore, the impugned order is liable to be set aside and accordingly, set aside.
